_comment: Real foreign-language speech for NPCs with no shared language. Every phrase is a real sentence in that tongue — never gibberish, never '[speaks Italian]'. Each entry: t (native text), en (translation, shown only via interpreter/translator/learning), kw (keyword glosses the player can catch while learning). fewWords: the handful of English fragments a zero-English speaker might know — the Mario energy.

need_water.en: Thirst is drying me. Can you give me water?

openers.t: Maakye! Wo... wo din de sɛn?
openers.en: Good morning! You... what is your name?
Hey... do you hear Twi? No? ...oh.

openers.t: Ɛyɛ me anigye sɛ wowɔ ha. Nokorɛ.

questions.en: Do they sleep here? Is it safe?

questions.t: Wo na... wo yɛ panyin wɔ ha?
questions.en: Is it you... you're the elder here?

warm.t: Mɛnwerɛ mfi saa adom yi da.
warm.en: I will never forget this favor.

need_food.t: Ɛkɔm de me. Mesrɛ... biribiara a medi.
need_food.en: Hunger has caught me. I beg... something to eat.
Hunger... big hunger.

need_food.t: Ɛkɔm bɛkum me. Mesrɛ wo, aduane.
need_food.en: Hunger will kill me. I beg you, food.

need_food.t: Kakraa bi pɛ. Biribiara a wobetumi adi.
need_food.en: Just a little. Anything you can eat.

need_help.en: Help... help me, I beg you.
I beg you, I need you.

need_water.t: Nsukɔm de me. Wobɛma me nsuo?
need_water.en: Thirst has caught me. Will you give me water?

openers.en: Hello! You... what is your name?
Hey... you speak Swahili? No? ...oh dear.

questions.t: Huku watu hulala wapi? Ni salama?
questions.en: Here where do people sleep? Is it safe?

warm.en: I will not forget this kindness.

need_food.t: Nina njaa. Tafadhali... kitu cha kula.
need_food.en: I have hunger. Please... something to eat.
Hunger... big hunger.
I'm dying of hunger. Please, food.
Just one piece. Anything edible.

need_danger.t: Usiende huko! Kuna kitu kinaishi huko.
